_about: cdimport does NOT read this file. It lists every setting with its built-in default.
To change settings, create ~/.config/cdimport/config.json (or pass --config FILE)
with only the keys you want to change; everything else keeps its default. Example:
Keys starting with an underscore, like this one, are comments and ignored.
_work_dir: Folder where rips land first and where unfinished albums are looked for. Empty: cdimport asks on first use and saves the answer here. -w DIR overrides it for one run.
_library_dir: Your music library; at the end cdimport offers to move the album there. Empty: cdimport asks on first use (suggesting the desktop's music folder) and saves the answer here. -l DIR overrides it for one run.
_library_layout: Where an album goes inside the library: {albumartist} comes from the tags, {folder} is the album folder's own name. '/' separates folder levels; the values are made safe as folder names, so 'AC/DC' cannot add a level.
_lyrics_mode: "ask" (each run, automatic preselected), "auto" (lyrembed --auto: embed confident matches without questions), "interactive" (choose for each track; lyrembed 0.8.0 and newer do that on a page in the browser) or "skip".
_editor: Tag editor to offer by default: a key from "editors", or "skip".
_editors: Tag editors, by key. "commands" lists alternatives; the first whose program (and, for 'flatpak run', the app) is installed is used. An argument that is exactly "{files}" becomes one argument per track; "{dir}" is replaced by the album folder. Flatpak editors get the files via --file-forwarding and @@ ... @@, because their sandbox may not see the working folder. Add your own entries here; the built-in ones stay.

cyanrip._channel: "release" installs the latest release (a distribution package where there is one, else a source build of the newest vX.Y.Z tag). "master" builds the master branch from source into ~/.local, also on systems with a package; use it when the release does not build against your FFmpeg. At start cdimport offers to update an outdated cyanrip, and to switch a release to master.
cyanrip._path: Path to the cyanrip program. Empty: search PATH, then ~/.local/bin (with channel master ~/.local/bin first, where that build goes).
cyanrip._device: CD drive, e.g. /dev/sr0. Empty: the drive cdimport finds an audio CD in.
cyanrip._offset: Drive read offset in samples (-s). cyanrip refuses to rip without one, so with null cdimport asks before the first rip: measure it with cyanrip -f (needs a disc in the AccurateRip database; saved without asking when at least 4 tracks confirm it), type it in, or use 0 for one rip.
cyanrip._mode: "fast" rips without paranoia (-P none), checks every track against AccurateRip and rips the tracks that do not match again with -P max; discs not in the AccurateRip database are ripped securely. "secure" always uses cyanrip's paranoia (-P max): about twice as slow, every block read in overlapping, verified pieces. --rip-mode overrides it for one run, p in the disc menu for one disc.
cyanrip._deemphasis: true (cyanrip's default) undoes preemphasis on discs flagged with it, since players ignore the flag. false passes -W: bit-exact, but such discs then sound too bright.
cyanrip._replaygain: Write ReplayGain tags (tags only, the audio is unchanged). false passes -K.
cyanrip._eject: Eject the disc after a successful rip (-Q).
cyanrip._dir_scheme: Album folder naming scheme (-D), relative to the working folder; see cyanrip's README. Empty: cyanrip's own default, which adds " [FLAC]".
cyanrip._extra_args: More cyanrip options, one list element per argument, e.g. ["-H"].

lyrembed._path: Path to the lyrembed program. Empty: search PATH, then ~/.local/bin.

_cyanrip_source_dir: Source checkout of a cyanrip built by cdimport (Fedora). Set by the installer; prefilled when rebuilding.
_cyanrip_build_dir: Meson build folder of that source build. Set by the installer.
_color: "auto", "always" or "never". auto honours NO_COLOR and non-terminal output.
